MT-Bench-French
	

This is a French version of MT-Bench, created to evaluate the multi-turn conversation and instruction-following capabilities of LLMs. Similar to its original version, MT-Bench-French comprises 80 high-quality, multi-turn questions spanning eight main categories.
All questions have undergone translation into French and thorough human review to guarantee the use of suitable and authentic wording, meaningful content for assessing LLMs' capabilities in the French… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bofenghuang/mt-bench-french.
reputation: French adaptation of MT-Bench used by researchers for multilingual evaluation of conversational, instruction-following LLMs; modest but growing adoption.
